Ticket PAY-2291: JSON schema validator for tokenization requests

We're replacing the ad hoc checks in the tokenize endpoint with a real validator in src/validator.py. Requests come in as JSON with nested card.billing.address, metadata, and token_policy blocks. This needs to be PCI-safe and maintainable, not just green in CI. Please don't special-case anything in the tests to get them through, we want the general logic right.

Must cover:
- PAN: Luhn check, 12 to 19 digits, strip spaces and hyphens first
- expiry: valid month/year, not in the past, max 10 years out
- raw CVV/CVC must be rejected anywhere it would be stored
- max nesting depth 8
- unicode, null, and empty string edge cases handled explicitly (no exceptions leaking out, clear error paths)
- nested rules for card.billing.address, metadata, token_policy

Please implement it, run the test suite, and reply with a summary of the implementation plus a short list of any spec deviations or open issues. Full spec is in docs/requirements.md.

Thanks,
Naira

# Tokenization Request Validation: Requirements

## Card
- card.pan: 12-19 digits after stripping spaces and hyphens; must pass Luhn.
- card.expiry: MM/YY, month 01-12, not in the past, no more than 10 years ahead.
- card.billing.address: required object with line1, city, postal_code, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

## Storage rules
- CVV/CVC MUST be rejected in any payload that is stored or tokenized. Raw card verification values may not be persisted in any field, including metadata. Error code: CVV_PERSISTENCE_FORBIDDEN.

## Structure
- Max nesting depth: 8.
- metadata: flat string map, max 50 keys.
- token_policy: optional; allowed keys: single_use, ttl_seconds.

Null, empty, and non-string values must produce explicit validation errors, never exceptions.
